石村！
破旧的山神庙，一个小胖子正气喘吁吁的朝着山神庙飞速奔跑。
一边奔跑一边大喊：“泥猴，你在家没在？”
等到他跑近山神庙一个瘦弱一身麻衣的少年出现在山神庙前面，正疑惑的打量着火急火燎的小胖子，不明白他遇到什么着急的事情跑得这样拼命。
“我在家的，胖子，发生什么事情了？”
小胖子来不及解释，拉起泥猴朝着村中跑去。
“边走边说，不然来不及了。”
一路跑着一路上小胖子对着少年解释：“泥猴，我们走大运了，有仙人降临石村招收弟子。
八岁到十五岁的少年都可以参加选拔，只要被选中，就可以进入仙门进行修炼，将来成为高高在上的仙人。”
少年愣住了，震惊的看着小胖子：“胖子，这世界真的有仙人？”
他很是不敢相信，仙人的传说他也听说过，可是仅仅是传说，真的有仙人他是不敢相信的，莫不是遇到了骗子？
胖子肯定的回道：“定是仙人无疑，我亲眼看到他们是从天上飞来，能吞云吐雾，你说不是仙人是什么？”
胖子表情很是自豪，他可是见过仙人的人了。
胖子都这样说，那一定是仙人了。
泥猴眼睛亮了起来，如果被仙人选中，岂不是可以不被人欺负，能够吃饱饭。
他立刻加快脚步朝着村子跑去。
小胖子有些跟不上泥猴的步伐，在身后大喊：“泥猴，等等我。”
两人一前一后的跑进村子。
在村口里人群里三层外三层，在最前面的是数十个符合检测条件的孩童，他们全部被集中在了一起。

只要被选中，不仅能够进入仙门修炼，还可以获得白银百两。
三个气宇非凡的白衫男女正冷漠的站在村口最中央，头发花白的村长正小心翼翼的陪衬着，大气都不敢出一声。
他可不敢得罪高高在上的仙人，不说他只是一个小小的村长，哪怕是赵国的国主见到仙人都要以礼相待。
中间的青年男子对着老村长说道。
“石村村长，你激活天恩令，按照规定太玄宗会为你们石村免费进行一次测试，符合条件有灵根的孩童将会进入太玄宗修炼。
但是老村长你不要报什么希望，灵根可不是那么好出现的，如若没有灵根出现，石村和太玄宗的因果也会就此了结。”
天恩令，背负宗门长老的因果，因果不了却，对修炼会有很大的影响。
只要激活天恩令，不管身在何方，仙门都会出现应予要求，满足其愿望，了却因果。
老村长自然知道这个道理，他也是数十年前救助了一位受伤的中年男子。
中年男子在石村养好伤之后留下一枚令牌，并告诉他有一天石村需要仙人的帮助就可以使用特殊方法激活令牌。
然后就飘然离去了。
他多番打听之下才知道这叫做天恩令，也被称为求仙令，是仙门中人一种还报凡俗恩情的方式。
激活天恩令，就会有仙人降临收徒，获得仙缘。

Ishimura!
In the dilapidated mountain temple, a little fat man was panting and running quickly towards the mountain temple.
While running, he shouted: "Ni Monkey, are you at home or not?"
When he approached the mountain temple, a thin young man dressed in sackcloth appeared in front of the mountain temple. He was looking at the anxious little fat man with confusion, wondering what urgent matter he encountered and why he was running so hard.
"I'm at home, Fatty, what happened?"
The little fat man didn't have time to explain, so he picked up the mud monkey and ran towards the village.
"Talking as we go, or it will be too late."
While running all the way, the little fat man explained to the young man: "Ni Monkey, we are in great luck. An immortal has come to Stone Village to recruit disciples.
Youngsters between the ages of eight and fifteen can participate in the selection. As long as they are selected, they can enter the Immortal Sect to practice and become a high-ranking immortal in the future. "
The young man was stunned and looked at the little fat man in shock: "Fat man, are there really immortals in this world?"
He couldn't believe it. He had also heard of the legend of immortals, but it was just a legend. He couldn't believe that there really were immortals. Could it be that he had met a liar?
The fat man replied firmly: "They must be immortals. I saw them flying from the sky with my own eyes. They can swallow clouds and spit mist. What do you think they are if they are not immortals?"
The fat man looked very proud. He had seen an immortal before.
Fat people say this, so they must be immortals.
The clay monkey's eyes lit up. If he was chosen by the immortal, wouldn't he be able to avoid being bullied and have enough to eat?
He immediately quickened his pace and ran towards the village.
The little fat man couldn't keep up with the pace of the clay monkey, so he shouted behind him: "Clay Monkey, wait for me."
The two ran into the village one after the other.
In the crowd at the entrance of the village, there were three layers outside and three layers outside. At the front were dozens of children who met the testing requirements, and they were all gathered together.
As long as you are selected, not only can you enter the Immortal Sect to practice, but you can also get a hundred taels of silver.
Three extraordinary men and women in white shirts were standing indifferently in the center of the village entrance. The gray-haired village chief was carefully accompanying them, not daring to make a sound.
He didn't dare to offend the superior immortal. Not to mention that he was just a small village chief. Even the leader of the Zhao Kingdom would treat the immortal with courtesy when he saw him.
The young man in the middle said to the old village chief.
"Head of Shicun, if you activate the Tian'en Order, according to the regulations, Taixuanzong will conduct a free test for your Shicun. Children who meet the conditions and have spiritual roots will enter Taixuanzong to practice.
But old village chief, don't give up any hope. Spiritual roots are not easy to appear. If no spiritual roots appear, the cause and effect between Shicun and Taixuanzong will be over. "
Tian'en Order carries the karma of the elders of the sect, and if the karma cannot be resolved, it will have a great impact on cultivation.
As long as the Tian'en Order is activated, no matter where you are, the Immortal Sect will appear to answer your requests, fulfill your wishes, and settle the cause and effect.
The old village chief naturally knew this truth. He also rescued an injured middle-aged man decades ago.
The middle-aged man left a token after Ishimura recovered from his injuries and told him that one day Ishimura would need the help of an immortal to activate the token using a special method.
Then he drifted away.
After much inquiring, he found out that this was called the Tian'en Order, also known as the Immortal Order. It was a way for people in the Immortal Sect to repay mortal kindness.
After activating the order of heaven's grace, an immortal will come to take you as a disciple and gain immortality.
